text.p: General Obligation Electric System Refunding Bonds, Series
SEALED BIDS will be received by the North Carolina Loca Government Commission (the LGC'') at the offices of the LGC in Raleigh, North Carolina, until 11:00 a.m., North Carolina Time, on

at which time and place said bids will be publicly opened and read, for the purchase of not less than all of the Town of Pineville, North Carolina General Obligation Electric System Refunding Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds shall be dated as of March 1, 1997, and shall mature annually on February 1 in the years 1998 through 2007, inclusive, and in the following principal amounts: $125,000* in 1998; $115,000* in 1999; $115,000* in 2000; $110,000* in 2001; $110,000 in 2002; $105,000* in 2003; $100,000* in 2004; $100,000* in 2005; $95,000* in 2006 and $90,000* in 2007.

The Town of Pineville, North Carolina (the Town'') may increase or decrease the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds by an amount not to exceed $10,000 and may increase or decrease the principal amount of any maturity of the Bonds by an amount not to exceed $5,000 per maturity following the opening of the bids, in accordance with the Detailed Notice of Sale. The Bonds are not subject to optional redemption prior to maturity. The Town has agreed in the resolution authorizing the issuance of the Bonds to comply with the continuing disclosure obligations imposed by Rule 15c2-12 promulgated by the Securities and Exchange Commission, as described in the Official Statement with respect to the Bonds. The Town has designated the Bonds as Qualified Tax- Exempt Obligations '' under Section 265 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

A bid must be for not less than all of the Bonds and must be not less than the 99% of par amount of the Bonds. Each bid must be accompanied by a certified or bank cashier's check or treasurer's check in the amount of $21,300.00, payable to the order of the State Treasurer of North Carolina, on which no interest will be allowed. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at the lowest interest cost to the Town, such cost to be determined in accordance with the TIC method. The Bonds, together with the approving opinion of Parker, Poe, Adams & Bernstein L.L.P., Charlotte, North Carolina, Bond Counsel, will be provided at the expense of the Town.
Additional information, including the detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at 325 North Salisbury Street, Fourth Floor, Raleigh, North Carolina 27603-1388.
